Jensen Huang discusses comeback as Nvidia CEO with allies

WaPo: Jensen Huang has kept a low profile since the scandal, but he’s involved in the search for his successor and has personally called at least one potential candidate.  It looks like Huang is trying to find his successor rather than make a comeback himself.

I’m starting to give more credence to the conspiracy theory that Jensen turned a blind eye to some of Nvidia’s advanced chips being smuggled into China.  If he did, I think it was because he believed it was in Nvidia’s best interest. I don’t think Chinese spies got to him.
